pattern: spend and limits question answered with one p0_code snippet
experience: Asked which chats cost the most and how much of an account's limit is left, an agent looks up the p0 API's TypeScript declarations with tool_search, then answers with one p0_code snippet that calls p0.usage. It does not guess numbers or read files.
rule: p0_code: run a snippet against the p0 API; search the API first.

source.note: p0code fork: usage and cost are exposed through one code tool instead of separate tools.

tools.name: p0_code
tools.description: Run a JavaScript snippet against the p0 API. declare namespace p0.usage { function limits(): Promise<{ accounts: Array<{ name: string; driver: string; exhausted: boolean; windows: Array<{ label: string; leftPercent: number; resetsAt?: string }> }> }>; function costs(options?: { since?: string; until?: string; projectId?: string; top?: number }): Promise<{ estimate: true; total: { costUsd: number }; topThreads: Array<{ threadId: string; title: string; costUsd: number }> }>; }

prompt: Which of my chats cost the most since Monday, and how much of my Claude weekly limit is left?
